description:
You are a professional home stager preparing the Contemporary House for a real estate listing. Empty rooms significantly reduce buyer appeal, so you must furnish all three key living spaces.

Furnishing requirements:
- Living Room: Place at least a sofa (or sectional/loveseat) AND a coffee table. Additional items (TV stand, bookcase, armchair) are welcome.
- Dining Room: Place a dining table AND at least two chairs around it.
- Bedroom (master or any bedroom): Place a bed AND at least one additional item (nightstand, dresser, wardrobe, or lamp).

After furnishing all three rooms, navigate to each room in the 3D view and export a separate image showing the furnished state:
1. Living room view → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\staged_living_room.jpg
2. Dining room view → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\staged_dining_room.jpg
3. Bedroom view → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\staged_bedroom.jpg

Note: DreamPlan is already running with the Contemporary House project loaded. Each exported image should clearly show the furniture you placed in that specific room.
